caption: One minute of the worked example: Nginx takes 1,000 requests, answers 700 from static files (11.7 req/s) and proxies 300 to Express (5 req/s). Express can do 25 req/s, so 20 req/s of its capacity stays unused.

spec.title: Serving 1,000 requests per minute
spec.aria: Browser sends 1,000 requests per minute to an Nginx web server, which answers 700 per minute (11.7 per second) from static files and proxies 300 per minute (5 per second) to an Express app server that queries a database, with Express capacity 25 per second leaving 20 per second spare.
